card.name: Start of a name after a break
card.fires_on: The first letter or piece of a proper name or brand name, or a short linking word, right after a place, list or phrase boundary. Often an uppercase T or Z that begins a capitalized name such as TUXARIN, TALICIA or Tana.

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: A capital T beginning an uppercase drug brand name after 'of' or 'in'.

modes.label: Place name start
modes.description: The first letter of a place name inside a list or after a preposition.
modes.example: borders Somalia to the East, Wajir and Isiolo to the North,<< T>>ana River to the West and Lamu

modes.label: Short word before a name
modes.description: A short word such as 'at' or an acronym that comes right before a named institution or program.
modes.example: The Dolan DNA Learning Center<< at>> Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory, an interactive primer

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are a mix of heart/inverse words and Chinese characters.
card.plain: It marks the opening letter of a capitalized name, such as a brand or place, where the next piece must continue the name.
